title: Why AI Won’t Replace You (But People Using AI Will)
description:
The biggest mistake business owners make with AI is asking it to think for them. If you treat AI like a magic button to solve your problems, you’re going to end up with generic results that don’t convert.

In this video, I talk about how to use AI-assisted automation to actually speed up your sales and marketing without losing your brand's voice. We aren't looking for robots to take over; we are looking for systems that give you an edge over your competitors. I’m breaking down the difference between generic automation and the smarter systems we build at Kodara to help you scale from operator to owner.

Comment “Scale with AI” if you want to scale your business 🔗
